title: Hearty Dutch Casserole
description: A comforting, layered casserole with a crispy topping.
instructions: Cook the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked sausage to a large bowl and add the sliced potatoes, carrots, and shredded lettuce.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk together to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in the heavy cream, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked sausage mixture to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
